family_policy: semantic paired contexts; JNLI image ID; JSQuAD paragraph; other question ID

score_policy.candidate_primary: sum conditional log likelihood of candidate body; no EOS
score_policy.candidate_secondary: mean conditional log likelihood per target token; no result-based selection
score_policy.boundary: protected newline; require prefix encoding to be exact prefix of joint encoding; otherwise reject
score_policy.ties: fractional credit 1/number_of_tied_maxima; report ties; first maximum only for confusion matrix
score_policy.jblimp_primary: train-sample SLOR; not a reproduction of original paper
score_policy.jnli_jcola: fixed balanced train exemplars; same exemplars for every dev example; label-string likelihood
score_policy.jsquad: 100 preselected dev answers; generation EM and character F1 separately from answer NLL; no truncation

new_acceptance: diagnostic only; CI lower bound above chance indicates above-chance evidence, not Base quality acceptance

long_generation.selection: first 2 per category in frozen dev order

external_reference: deferred; chance/majority/train-unigram controls in initial report; no reference weight download required
JMMLU: deferred P3 after foundational diagnostics; not initial report acceptance
